prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Pet Companion", "Select a friend to live on your desktop and keep you company while you work.", "Available Companions"]
1: ["Define Your Pet's Personality", "Choose how playful, vocal, or active your companion will be on screen.", "Save Personality", "Pet Temperament"]
2: ["Your Companion is Ready on Desktop!", "Quick Guide: Click pet to interact, press Alt+P to hide/show, or right-click for controls menu.", "Start Desktop Session", "Essential Desktop Controls"]
3: ["Verifying Desktop Visibility", "Can you see your pet active on your screen right now?", "Yes, Pet is Visible!"]
4: ["Welcome to Your Interactive Desktop Companion", "Adopt a digital pet that wanders on screen, reacts to your workflow, and keeps you energized all day.", "Begin Setup Journey"]
5: ["Signing in secures your pet traits, adoption record, and custom settings permanently in the cloud."]
6: ["Official Adoption Certificate Granted", "Adopting completes your starter profile and unlocks bonus desktop animations!", "Certified Companion Owner"]
7: ["Initializing Desktop Pet Animation Engine...", "Preparing desktop workspace shaders, sound effects, and pet behaviors."]
8: ["We'll send a system alert as soon as your pet arrives on screen."]
9: ["Quick Startup Checklist"]
